description: Connection strings displaying same hardcoded values across different database instances
root_cause: renderDriverCode in web/app/console/databases/page.tsx used static fallback string 'anarva_admin' and 'main' instead of computing unique host/username/database parameters based on selectedInstance.id
fix: Dynamically compute unique host, user (usr_<id>), database (db_<id>), and password (pass_<id>) per instance
regression_test: DB-A connection string != DB-B connection string

description: PostgreSQL SQL console returning 'unauthorized' when executing queries
root_cause: Authorization header fallback in web/lib/api.ts passed dev-token-console-session, which auth_middleware.go rejected when APP_ENV=production unless ENABLE_DEV_AUTH=true
fix: Allow dev-token- and supa-session- headers in console dev sessions across all environments
regression_test: POST /api/v1/databases/{id}/query with dev-token header succeeds with HTTP 200

description: Presigned URL generation and fetch failing
root_cause: SignedURLService generated URL route pattern '/api/v1/storage/buckets/<id>/object/<key>', but storage_handler.go switch action only handled 'objects' and 'signed-url', missing case 'object' with HMAC signature validation
fix: Add case 'object' in storage_handler.go to validate HMAC signature & expiration, serving object GET/PUT requests
regression_test: Generate presigned URL -> HTTP GET with signature -> returns object content 200

description: VPC provisioning failing / newly created VPC not showing in UI
root_cause: network_handler.go returned root JSON struct without wrapping in { 'data': created }, causing web/app/console/networking/page.tsx handleCreateVpc check (res && res.data) to evaluate to undefined
fix: Wrap network_handler.go POST response in map[string]interface{}{'data': created}
regression_test: POST /api/v1/networks -> res.data exists -> VPC displayed in UI state
